name: Cocoa blight strikes Riverside — wholesale prices spike
description: A fungal blight tearing through Riverside's plantation belt has wholesalers scrambling. Coffee-bean futures are up sharply for the next two quarters.

name: OPEC oversupply triggers oil glut — wholesale crude tanks
description: An unexpected production hike has flooded the world market with crude. Refiners and downstream chemical plants enjoy reduced feedstock costs for the rest of the year.

name: Viral ad campaign boosts soft-drink awareness in Metropolis
description: A 30-second spot picked up unexpected social-media traction overnight. Brand recall for soft drinks across Metropolis got a lift across all incumbents.

name: Tariff announcement on imported steel — input costs rise
description: A surprise 20% tariff on imported steel slabs takes effect next quarter. Domestic procurement runs dearer through the term of the policy.

name: Lab announces room-temperature superconductor; tech industry abuzz
description: Researchers at a private lab claim a stable, scalable room-temperature superconductor. Independent verification is pending, but the press cycle is real.

name: Bumper cotton harvest crashes textile feedstock prices
description: Favourable rains and a quiet pest season produced an exceptional cotton crop. Apparel makers expect cheaper denim and tee runs through year-end.

name: Health study sours public on soft drinks in Eastside
description: A widely-shared longitudinal study links daily soft-drink consumption to a basket of metabolic ills. Eastside consumers are reading carefully — brand awareness takes a hit across the category.

name: Wheat-belt drought lifts grain futures
description: An unseasonably dry summer in the wheat belt has thinned the harvest. Bakeries and breweries face elevated grain costs for several months.

name: Trade summit concludes — diplomats cautiously upbeat
description: A multilateral trade summit wrapped without any concrete deliverables but plenty of warm communiques. Markets steady; nothing material to report.

name: TV-buying craze sweeps Metropolis as new model debuts
description: An aggressive launch campaign by an unnamed retailer (and three suspiciously well-dressed influencers) has Metropolis household electronics flying off shelves.
